item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence that AMLO’s system was designed to reduce intermediaries and commissions, and strong warnings that social programs could be used politically.\nI did not find solid independent 2024 proof that AMLO systematically withheld benefits from opponents or formally conditioned access on partisan loyalty.\nThe clearest negative evidence is timing and risk: pre-blackout payment acceleration, repeated INE warnings, and opposition allegations. That is enough for a mixed judgment, but not enough to prove a fully entrenched patronage machine.","evidence":[{"title":"Entrega directa de Programas para el Bienestar abate la corrupción","publisher":"Programas para el Bienestar","date":"2024-10-17","url":"https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/entrega-directa-de-programas-para-el-bienestar-abate-la-corrupcion/","summary":"The government said social-program money now goes directly to beneficiaries through Banco del Bienestar cards, with intermediaries and commissions removed. This is evidence of continuity and an attempt to keep benefits detached from political turnover.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.5"]},{"title":"Aclaración.
